metadata.mechanics:
This procedure can be used at the same time as the crafting of any Necrology item, adding the expenditure of 1 Resolve. For every willing or helpless Lineage killed during the procedure (they can be killed by assistants or by the crafter, for whom the Killing Blow call does not interrupt crafting), the materials needed for the Necrology crafting can be reduced by 1 Grave Flesh, 1 Infection Material, or 1 Imprint Crystal. If Infection loss is prevented for any of the Targets, this procedure fails. 

Completion of this procedure causes rank 3 zombies to spawn somewhere on site within the next few hours, at least one per killed Lineage but often more.
metadata.requirementsToUse: The Organic Machine & Society Membership: The Dead Market
metadata.validTargetDescription: Any number of willing or helpless Lineage Targets and one willing crafter.
metadata.locationOfUse: Same as the modified crafting project.
metadata.durationOfRoleplay: Same as the modified crafting project.
metadata.descriptionOfRoleplay: Sometimes there just aren't enough resources to go around, especially when you're a necrologist. Fortunately for those of less-ethical mindsets, there are shortcuts around the tedious and often expensive ways of gathering such resources. Through Sedlec Engineering, living Lineages can be dismantled and incorporated directly into necrological projects, their still-living organs, flesh, and parts used as raw materials. This invariably fatal process tends to cause disturbances in the local Mortis, but those willing or desperate enough to go to these extremes rarely worry about further collateral damage.
